clue.text: Who'll do supper for Meryl's shows?

definitions.note: one who will do, that is perform, on stage

indicators.note: the run of letters shows itself across the words supper, for and Meryl's

explanation.surface: Someone asks who will cook supper for Meryl's dinner shows.
explanation.walkthrough: Meryl (Streep) is herself a famous actor, so the surface quietly supports the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor or entertainer is someone who will 'do' a turn, that is put on an act for an audience.

clue.text: A quantity of pickled peppers picked to nibble

definitions.text: A quantity of pickled peppers picked
definitions.meaning: first meaning: the measure in the tongue-twister 'Peter Piper picked a ... of pickled peppers'
second meaning: to eat in small bites, as a bird does

explanation.surface: A tongue-twister about pickled peppers, offered as a snack to nibble.
explanation.definitionFit: The dry measure of two gallons features in the nursery rhyme; as a verb it also means to bite at food lightly.

clue.text: Dish to stir, mixing round

indicators.note: mixing tells us to jumble the letters of the pieces together

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: stir the dish, mixing it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian rice dish cooked slowly with stock.

clue.text: Lyric poem found in Hesiod especially

indicators.note: the answer is found within the run of letters across Hesiod and especially

explanation.surface: A lyric poem turns up in the works of the Greek poet Hesiod.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a lyrical poem addressed to a subject, often in elevated style.

clue.text: Masculine outlook is butcher

parts.note: M is the grammatical abbreviation for masculine
an angle is a point of view or outlook

explanation.surface: A statement that the male outlook amounts to that of a butcher.
explanation.definitionFit: To mangle something is to hack, mutilate or ruin it, as a clumsy butcher would.

clue.text: Ruling about turning up is unacceptable

indicators.note: the ruling word goes about, around, the other piece

parts.note: regnant means reigning, ruling

indicators.note: turning means the word up is read backwards

explanation.surface: A judge's ruling about something turning up is deemed unacceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: Repugnant means offensive or distasteful, so not to be tolerated or accepted.

clue.text: Down south and missing north

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south

indicators.note: missing means the word and goes without one of its letters

parts.note: N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: Compass directions: heading down south and missing the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down' looks like a direction alongside south and north, but it is the definition, meaning low in spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling down is an idiom for being unhappy or low in spirits.

clue.text: Game hedgehog going at some speed

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Sega's blue video-game hedgehog mascot
second meaning: relating to the speed of sound

explanation.definitionFit: Sonic the Hedgehog is the video-game character; the adjective describes travel at the speed of sound.

clue.text: Departs before time and at great cost

parts.note: D is the timetable abbreviation for departs
early means before the expected time

explanation.surface: Someone leaves ahead of schedule and pays a heavy price for it.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay dearly is to pay a high price, a common idiom for something costly.

clue.text: One small seabird beside cold reservoir

indicators.note: beside tells us the cold piece sits next to the others

parts.note: C is the tap abbreviation for cold
the Roman numeral I is one
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A lone little seabird perches by a cold reservoir.
explanation.definitionFit: A cistern is a tank for storing water, a small reservoir.

clue.text: What makes dad a native of China?

parts.note: dad is pa, a word of two letters; the answer reads as those two letters joined by a conjunction, which together make it

explanation.surface: A riddle asking what turns a man into a father in China.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as 'P and A': those two letters spell PA, dad.
explanation.definitionFit: The giant panda is a bear found wild only in the mountains of China.

clue.text: Eg, a loincloth is out of order in referring to peoples and cultures

indicators.note: letters out of order are jumbled, so these are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A loincloth worn out of place is a cultural faux pas.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethnology is the study of the characteristics of different peoples and their cultures.

clue.text: Anniversary — then tie-in needs developing

definitions.note: taken as the name of a particular anniversary

indicators.note: the letters need developing, working into a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A marketing tie-in for an anniversary still needs developing.
explanation.definitionFit: A ninetieth is the anniversary marking ninety years since an event.

clue.text: Swindle involving one currency item

indicators.note: involving means the swindle word wraps round the other piece

parts.note: a con is a swindle
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A fraud involving a single item of currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A coin is a piece of metal money, one item of a currency.

clue.text: Sadly, a girl loses her last son

definitions.note: an interjection expressing regret, used where 'sadly' would be

indicators.note: the girl word loses its final letter

parts.note: lass is a word for a girl
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A sad tale: a girl loses her youngest son.
explanation.definitionFit: Alas is an exclamation of grief or regret, like 'unfortunately'.

clue.text: One green and largely stoned in a mostly noisy party?

indicators.note: mostly means all but the final letter of the noisy word is kept

parts.note: vocal means loud, noisy
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A green-faced reveller, largely stoned, at a loud party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stoned' suggests intoxication; here it means having a stone, and this fruit has a large one.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocado is a green-skinned fruit with a very large central stone.

clue.text: Bishop managed church division

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
ran means managed

explanation.surface: A bishop is in charge of a division of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A branch is a subdivision or local office of a larger organisation.

clue.text: Bird, one good in open flying

indicators.note: in places these letters inside the rearranged open
flying signals the letters of open are scattered

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A bird, a good one, flying in the open air.
explanation.definitionFit: The pigeon is a common plump grey bird found in towns.

clue.text: Pirate upset splitting share getting sent home

definitions.note: a noun phrase: the process of being sent home

indicators.note: splitting means the jumbled piece goes inside, splitting the share word

parts.note: a ration is a fixed share

indicators.note: upset means the letters of Pirate are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A disgruntled pirate splits the loot before being shipped home.
explanation.definitionFit: Repatriation is the return of a person to their own country.

clue.text: Photo of queen included in volume

indicators.note: included in means this goes inside the volume word

parts.note: a pint is a volume of liquid
R is the abbreviation for queen, from Regina

explanation.surface: A photograph of the Queen appears inside a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' suggests a book, but here it is a measure of liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: A print is a photographic image produced on paper.

clue.text: Plant in river amid wetland

indicators.note: amid means this goes in the middle of the wetland word

parts.note: a fen is low marshy land
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A plant grows in a river running through marshland.
explanation.definitionFit: A fern is a flowerless plant with feathery fronds.

clue.text: Innocent I has divided part of church

indicators.note: has divided means the I splits the church word in two

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church

explanation.surface: A first-person confession of splitting a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Innocent' looks like a pope's name next to church, but it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive means lacking experience or guile, unworldly and trusting.

clue.text: Bind queen's lavender, stripping outer pieces

indicators.note: stripping the outer pieces of queen's lavender leaves letters from its inside

explanation.surface: Tying up the queen's lavender after pulling off the outer leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: To enslave someone is to bind them into servitude.

clue.text: It's artful and crafty, ultimately

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: A description of something clever and cunning at heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Sly means cunning and artful, so the whole clue also describes the word.

clue.text: Great success with hospital information technology

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A new hospital computer system proves a triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: A hit is a song, show or venture that proves very popular.

clue.text: Sweetheart low with start of new period after wedding

parts.note: honey is a term of endearment for a sweetheart
to low is to moo like a cow

indicators.note: start of means take the first letter of new

explanation.surface: A sweetheart feels low at the start of a new married period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low' looks like a mood, but it is the verb for a cow's call.
explanation.definitionFit: A honeymoon is the holiday a couple take immediately after their marriage.
